svg.title: Mark a range in a saved recording
svg.desc: In Files, preview a saved recording and choose Review in Editor. Pause at the first point and choose Mark start, then seek to the last point and choose Mark end. The selected range can open an annotation draft or produce a separate trimmed file.

path.aria-label: Mark a range in a saved recording
In Files, preview the recording and choose Review in Editor…
Review the draft in the original task.
Check the separate output and coverage.
Playback times mark a selection. Review observed coverage after trimming.
